sourceAssessment.rationale: The proposed Japanese explanation correctly separates two existing parts of correct choice C: the Runtime inbound authorizer validates the JWT, while application access to claims requires forwarding the Authorization header through the request-header allowlist. The inbound-authorizer documentation states that Runtime uses the configured OIDC discovery URL to obtain keys and validates allowed audiences against the JWT aud claim. The Runtime OAuth guide states that an application may propagate Authorization through the allowlist and decode claims without revalidating the signature because inbound authorization has already validated the token. Thus the claims are derived from the already-validated JWT, not from a self-reported prompt or arbitrary payload. The change clarifies the original JWT-validation approach without changing the prompt, choice texts, correct C, or its security intent.

sources.evidence: The inbound authorizer validates JWTs before allowing access, uses the configured OIDC discovery URL to obtain validation information, and validates allowed audiences against the JWT aud claim.

Step 7 identifies Authorization propagation through the request-header allowlist as the path for extracting claims in agent code, and says the application can skip signature validation because Runtime has already validated the token during inbound authorization.
Authorization can be forwarded to agent code when Runtime uses a custom JWT authorizer and the request-header allowlist includes Authorization.

edits.before: This lets the application validate the caller’s identity.
edits.after: The Runtime's inbound authorizer validates the JWT. To use claims in the application, add the Authorization header to the allowlist so it is forwarded, then extract them from the validated token.

JWT validation by AgentCore Runtime and token propagation to the application are separate settings. Configure the OIDC discovery URL and allowed audience, and configure Authorization forwarding to access claims.

La validation JWT par AgentCore Runtime et la transmission du jeton à l’application sont des configurations distinctes. Configurez l’URL de découverte OIDC et l’audience autorisée, puis configurez la transmission d’Authorization pour accéder aux claims.

Die JWT-Validierung durch AgentCore Runtime und die Tokenweitergabe an die Anwendung sind getrennte Einstellungen. Konfigurieren Sie die OIDC-Discovery-URL und die zulässige Audience sowie die Weiterleitung von Authorization, um auf Claims zuzugreifen.

La validación de JWT por AgentCore Runtime y la propagación del token a la aplicación son configuraciones independientes. Configure la URL de descubrimiento de OIDC y las audiencias permitidas (audience), y configure el reenvío de Authorization para acceder a los claims.
